text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick drop  I'm putting together a compact one-pager managers can use at quarterly handoffs. Goal: make 1:1s faster and self-reviews easier.

Ethan (Eng Manager): nice. can it be printable so managers can scribble notes?

Maya (People Ops): yep PDF + markdown. kept the card to one side of A4. layout = goal (1 line), why (1 sentence), metrics (1 line), blockers (1 line), help needed (1 line).

Lina (IC): can we include an example for cross-functional goals (eg. infra + product)? those always cause ambiguity.

Maya (People Ops): added a cross-functional header and explicit owner list. example: 

```
Goal (1-line): Improve embed freshness for user search results
Why: reduce stale results that lower click-through for new content
Owner(s): Lina (ML infra), Carlos (Product PM)
Metrics: increase new-content CTR by 5 percentage points in 30 days; embedding refresh latency < 5m
Blocker: infra rollout of streaming pipeline
Help needed: product to prioritize experiment window; infra for scaling config
```

Carlos (Product): love that. can we add a short "expected time split" field when goals span teams? helps managers set bandwidth expectations.

Maya (People Ops): done. new optional field: "Estimated weekly focus" (0-100%). default template suggests 20/40/60 split examples.

Ethan (Eng Manager): any guidance for writing success criteria for exploratory work? metrics there are fuzzy.

Maya (People Ops): added three patterns for exploratory goals: 
- output metric (deliverable shipped + acceptance test)
- learning milestone (experiment run + doc summarizing outcomes)
- decision point (fork/continue documented with next steps)

Lina (IC): sweet. can we add a tiny manager checklist for handoff acceptance? short yes/no bullets.

Maya (People Ops): included a 4-line manager acceptance check: 
- Is the goal outcome-oriented? (Y/N)
- Are success criteria measurable or clearly defined? (Y/N)
- Do owners and deputies match the scope? (Y/N)
- Is expected time commitment reasonable? (Y/N)

OpsBot: Reminder: Any update to People Ops templates will be synchronized to the Knowledge Hub within 24 hours.

Carlos (Product): for peer feedback, can we have one template with 3 quick prompts so reviewers can answer in 60s?

Maya (People Ops): created a micro-review card: 
- One line summary of outcome
- One suggestion to improve impact
- One low-friction ask the owner could do next quarter
Optional: "One thing to stop doing" as a calibration prompt.

Ethan (Eng Manager): this looks ready. can you add a TL;DR card managers can paste into 1:1 calendar invites?

Maya (People Ops): yes, TL;DR added. I'll upload the PDF, markdown, and TL;DR paste blocks to #docs and tag the manager group. planning to include in the self-review checklist too.

Lina (IC): thanks! i'll use this at our kickoff on monday.

Maya (People Ops): thanks everyone 44D — ping me if you spot wording that's vague.
